ruleDefinitions.name: Azure Keyvault Secrets Modified or Deleted
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies when secrets are modified or deleted in Azure. Note: Unmapped fields: operationName

sequences.query: (operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KEYVAULT\/VAULTS\/SECRETS\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KEYVAULT\/VAULTS\/SECRETS\/DELETE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KEYVAULT\/VAULTS\/SECRETS\/BACKUP\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KEYVAULT\/VAULTS\/SECRETS\/PURGE\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KEYVAULT\/VAULTS\/SECRETS\/UPDATE\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KEYVAULT\/VAULTS\/SECRETS\/RECOVER\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KEYVAULT\/VAULTS\/SECRETS\/RESTORE\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KEYVAULT\/VAULTS\/SECRETS\/SETSECRET\/ACTION")
